title: charter_freshness advisory is noise: 0 true catches of 7 fires; retire it
detail: Adjudicated an adopter's catch ledger 2026-11-21: charter_freshness fired at 7 consecutive sprint-starts (8→13 completed sprints since design/product.md changed) and the charter was never revised; 0 true / 7 false. The second adopter never reached the threshold. The signal is content-blind: it counts completed sprints since the charter file's mtime, so a stable product with a stable charter is flagged forever, and a checkout that touches mtime silences it. Retire the advisory: remove the sprint-start check and the shipped config block, have refresh remove the shipped-default block from adopter configs (name a customised one as no longer read), keep the historical fire mapping so past fires and their labels still render.
